outcome: branch (a) both contribute: a trained body and the copied routing affinity each buy something, so cloning is two effects and neither is the whole of section 5.26
summary_note: Section 5.27. R, B and C are the same seed, initial model and data schedule, every event forced to a grow, differing only in whether a grown expert is freshly drawn (R), a clone of the layer's busiest survivor's BODY with a fresh router row (B), or that body with the survivor's router row copied too (C). The three settings choose the same final genome, so B-R is the trained body's contribution and C-B is the routing affinity's. Negative means the first-named run won.
